A little surprise from your Anna 🫶

A small letter from Anna 💌

Konjam emotional… konjam comedy… full-ah paasam.

Dear Abinaya, Namma rendu perum ethana sanda potalum, ethana thadava oruthara oruthar thittinalum, un mela enakku irukkura paasam eppovume koraiyaadhu. Nee kovakari dhaan… aana un manasu romba soft. Naan kooda irundha kovapaduva; naan illa na enna nenachu varuthapaduva. Nee enga ellarukkum cook panni kudukkuradhu, enakku help venumna udaney pannuradhu — idhellam naan marakka maaten. Unna naan thittite iruppen, nee ennaye thittite iruppa 😂 Aana namma sanda kooda oru cute memory dhaan. Unna yaaravadhu hurt panna naan summa irukka maaten! Eppovume Anna un kooda iruppen. Kavala padadha. Unakku enna problem irundhaalum, enna help venumnaalum, en kitta sollu. Unakku support-ah naan iruppen. Amma, Appa health-ah nalla paathuko. Avanga nalla aarokiyama, santhoshama irukkanum. Namma ellarum onna, happy-ah, healthy-ah irukkanum. Adhu dhaan enakku romba mukkiyam. Un life-la neraya happiness, success, love, peace irukkanum. Nee un dreams ellathayum achieve pannanum. Happy Birthday, once again 😇 — Un Anna
